question: In 1897, who founded 'Ramakrishna Mission'? (RPF Constable 2018 (22/01/2019) Shift 3)
options: Acharya Narendra Dev
Ramakrishna Paramhansa
Madan Mohan Malaviya
Swami Vivekananda
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Swami Vivekananda

Explanation:
The Ramakrishna Mission was founded in 1897 by Swami Vivekananda. It is a spiritual and philanthropic organization based on the ideals of Ramakrishna Paramhansa. Its headquarters is at Belur Math, West Bengal. The mission works in the fields of education, healthcare, and social service. Swami Vivekananda was the foremost disciple of Ramakrishna Paramhansa and spread Vedanta philosophy to the West.

स्वामी विवेकानंद

question: What treaty with British did Ranjit Singh accept British rights over Sis-Sutlej territories? (RPF Constable 2018 (22/01/2019) Shift 3)
options: Treaty of Amritsar
Treaty of Sindh
Treaty of Pushkar
Treaty of Salbai
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Treaty of Amritsar

Explanation:
In 1809, Maharaja Ranjit Singh signed the Treaty of Amritsar with the British, accepting their rights over the Cis-Sutlej territories (south of the Sutlej river). As per the treaty, the Sutlej river was fixed as the boundary between the two powers. In return, the British recognized Ranjit Singh's independence. This treaty took place during the tenure of Governor-General Lord Minto. The other options—Treaty of Sindh, Treaty of Pushkar, and Treaty of Salbai—are unrelated to this event. Hence, the Treaty of Amritsar is the correct answer.

☛ Result of Treaty of Amritsar → Sutlej river became boundary
☛ British Governor-General at that time → Lord Minto
☛ Ranjit Singh's rule area → North of Sutlej (Punjab)
☛ Cis-Sutlej region referred to → South of Sutlej
question_hi: रंजीत सिंह ने किस संधि के माध्यम से ब्रिटिशों को सतलुज के दक्षिण में स्थित क्षेत्रों पर अधिकार स्वीकार किया था? (RPF Constable 2018 (22/01/2019) Shift 3)

सिंध की संधि
पुष्कर की संधि
साल्बाई की संधि
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है अमृतसर की संधि

Explanation:
रंजीत सिंह ने 1809 में अमृतसर की संधि के तहत ब्रिटिशों को सतलुज के दक्षिण (सिस-सतलुज) के क्षेत्रों पर अधिकार स्वीकार किया। इस संधि में सतलुज नदी को दोनों शक्तियों के बीच सीमा माना गया। इसके बदले ब्रिटिशों ने रंजीत सिंह की स्वतंत्रता को मान्यता दी। यह संधि लॉर्ड मिंटो के गवर्नर-जनरल काल में हुई थी। सिंध की संधि और पुष्कर की संधि अन्य घटनाओं से जुड़ी हैं, जबकि साल्बाई की संधि मराठों से संबंधित है। अतः अमृतसर की संधि ही सही उत्तर है।

question: What was the first mass strike of Indian freedom struggle? (RPF Constable 2018 (22/01/2019) Shift 3)
options: Roulette Satyagraha
Ahmedabad Mill Strike
Kheda Satyagrah
Champaran Satyagraha
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Roulette Satyagraha

Explanation:
The first mass strike of the Indian freedom struggle was the Roulette Satyagraha. It began on 6 April 1919 when Mahatma Gandhi called for a nationwide strike and Satyagraha against the Roulette Act, which was introduced by the British government to suppress civil liberties. People peacefully observed strikes, closed shops, and held demonstrations. This movement led to the Jallianwala Bagh massacre. The Roulette Satyagraha is considered the first all-India level mass protest in the freedom struggle.

☛ What was the nature of the Roulette Satyagraha? → Mass strike and Satyagraha

चंपारण सत्याग्रह

Explanation:
भारतीय स्वतंत्रता संग्राम का पहला सामूहिक हड़ताल रौलेट सत्याग्रह था। यह 6 अप्रैल 1919 को शुरू हुआ, जब महात्मा गांधी ने रौलेट एक्ट के विरोध में देशव्यापी हड़ताल और सत्याग्रह का आह्वान किया। यह एक्ट ब्रिटिश सरकार द्वारा नागरिक स्वतंत्रता को कुचलने के लिए लाया गया था। इस आंदोलन में लोगों ने शांतिपूर्वक हड़ताल की, दुकानें बंद कीं और प्रदर्शन किए। इसके बाद ही जलियांवाला बाग नरसंहार हुआ। रौलेट सत्याग्रह को स्वतंत्रता संग्राम में पहला अखिल भारतीय स्तर का सामूहिक विरोध माना जाता है।

question: Who was the president of the first session of the Indian National Congress? (RPF Constable 2018 (24/01/2019) Shift 1)
options: George Yule
W. C. Bannerjee
a. O Hume
Grandfather Nairobi
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is W. C. Bannerjee

Explanation:
The first session of the Indian National Congress was held in Bombay in 1885. Its president was Womesh Chandra Bannerjee (W. C. George Yule became Congress president in 1888, while Dadabhai Naoroji served as president in 1886 and 1893. Hence, the correct answer is W. C. Bannerjee.

question: In which congress session was the Gandhi-Irwin accord supported? (RPF Constable 2018 (24/01/2019) Shift 1)
options: Bombay
Lahore
Karachi
Madras
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Karachi

Explanation:
The Gandhi-Irwin Pact was signed on March 5, 1931 between Mahatma Gandhi and the then Viceroy Lord Irwin. Under this agreement, the Civil Disobedience Movement was withdrawn and Gandhi agreed to participate in the Second Round Table Conference. To formally approve this pact, the Indian National Congress held its annual session in Karachi in March 1931, presided over by Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. The session endorsed the agreement and also passed resolutions on Fundamental Rights and Economic Policy. This session is significant in Congress history as it also adopted the tricolor as the national flag. The Gandhi-Irwin Pact was the first direct agreement between the British government and the Congress.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ Date of signing Gandhi-Irwin Pact → 5 March 1931
☛ President of Karachi session → Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
☛ Resolution passed in Karachi session → Fundamental Rights and Economic Policy
☛ Decision on national flag at Karachi session → Adopted tricolor
question_hi: गांधी-इरविन समझौते का समर्थन किस कांग्रेस अधिवेशन में किया गया था? (RPF Constable 2018 (24/01/2019) Shift 1)

question: Which of the following is known as World Kavi?  (RPF Constable 2018 (24/01/2019) Shift 3)
options: Rabindranath Tagore
Balanggadhar Tilak
Subrahmanya Bharti
V. O. Chidambaram Pillai
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Rabindranath Tagore

Explanation:
Rabindranath Tagore is known as World Kavi due to his immense literary and poetic genius. He was a towering figure in Indian literature, awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913 for his collection of poems 'Gitanjali'. His poetry encompasses spirituality, love for nature, and profound humanism. Tagore seamlessly blended Indian cultural traditions with Western thought, earning global recognition. He composed the national anthems of two nations: India's 'Jana Gana Mana' and Bangladesh's 'Amar Shonar Bangla'. He is also respectfully called 'Gurudev'. Tagore's contributions span literature, music, and art, making him a universal poet whose works continue to inspire generations worldwide.

☛ Where was Rabindranath Tagore born? → Kolkata

question: Who was the first Viceroy of India? (RPF Constable(Ancillary) 2018 (29/03/2019) Shift 2)

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Lord Canning

Explanation:
The first Viceroy of India was Lord Canning. He served from 1858 to 1862. During his tenure, the Indian Penal Code (IPC) was enacted in 1860 and the Indian High Courts Act was passed in 1861.
